summary: Tested public health and upload validation APIs plus mobile homepage, file selection, preview, error, and overflow behavior. Core validation and UI checks passed; live summary generation was blocked by a preview-host 502.

critical.issue: A valid text PDF upload returned Cloudflare HTML 502 Bad Gateway from the public preview instead of a summary response; live Gemini workflow could not be verified.

integration_issues.issue: End-to-end result rendering, tabs, copy/download, and reset could not be reached because the public upload request returned 502.

action_items: Investigate the public preview/backend availability causing POST /api/upload to return Cloudflare 502; rerun live Gemini and result-control tests afterward.
critical_code_review_comments: The backend upload path is structurally sound, but live availability/integration remains unverified due to the public 502.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for executed checks; result flow untested

context_for_next_testing_agent: Health, unsupported type, empty file, oversized file, homepage, image preview, mobile overflow, and unsupported-type UI error passed. Valid PDF POST reached public Cloudflare 502 before application response; test result tabs/copy/download/new-document after service recovery.
rca of the issue: The valid PDF request was sent to the configured external preview URL and received a Cloudflare-generated 502 HTML page, indicating preview host/upstream availability failure rather than a validated application JSON error. No Gemini response was observed.
